scope: The standing white marble shrine at Hazratbal, Srinagar. Includes the mapped prayer-house envelope with its terrace and wings, the separately traced main dome, the single minaret, and the defining exterior arcade and lattice work.
geometryBasis: Named building way 517005631 with separately mapped dome 648175643 and native precinct relation 20018899. Uses the exact building footprint, roof dome center in its signed plan and untouched shoreline terrain.
sectionBasis: White marble envelope, approximately 15.4 m mapped main dome on a pierced drum, tall faceted minaret with an open lantern, terrace parapet and recurrent pointed arcade from the inspected originals. Grounds are referenced to the native front grade.
limitations: The native building outline and traced dome fix plan and scale. Minaret position, building height, service wing roofs and hidden façades are estimates from the public-domain views and map.
Shared stone and metal materials approximate marble joints, gilding, lattice and carved bands. The roof terraces and window divisions use reconstructed proportions.
The original elevation tile represents the present shore and stays unchanged. Exact vertical contact and ground below the terraces are approximate at available DEM resolution.
